Code of Civil Procedure, 1908: Or. VII, r.11 - Rejection of plaint - Held: The power u/Or. VII, r.11 can be exercised by the Court at any stage of the suit - The relevant facts which need to be looked into for deciding the application are the averments of the plaint only - If on reading of the plaint, it is found that the suit is manifestly vexatious and merit/ess in the sense of not disclosing any right to sue, the court should exercise power u/Or.
